title: Pressure Quotients and Endpoint Velocity-Clock Criteria for Non-Diffusive Viscoelastic Flows
summary: We prove endpoint continuation criteria for stress-diffusion-free incompressible viscoelastic flows by working modulo pressure. In two space dimensions, the pressure-free part of any smooth spectral isotropic stress reduces to a single active deviatoric channel (q_1(a,|Y|^2)Y), where (C=aI+Y) and (\operatorname{tr}Y=0). This scalar quotient structure allows a weighted active-deviatoric energy to cancel the top-order coupling between polymer stretching and the divergence of the active stress.
